profile.headline: Software Engineer VI at Apple
profile.summary:
Systems engineer at Apple in the Vision Products Group, with a focus on next-generation hardware, software, and AI.

Over twenty years of professional software engineering experience spanning a mix of operating system, console game, and mobile app development.

positions.title: Software Engineer VI, Vision Products Group
positions.description: The work is mysterious and important.

positions.title: Software Engineer V, Vision Products Group
positions.description: Systems engineer on the ARKit team. Responsible for the architecture, implementation, and integration of real-time spatial tracking, scene understanding, and people understanding algorithms in visionOS.

positions.title: Software Engineer V, Video Apps Engineering
positions.description: Systems engineer on the AR camera effects engine that was introduced as a feature in FaceTime and the Messages camera in iOS 12, allowing you to transform yourself into an Animoji or Memoji, apply filters, and more.

positions.title: Lead iOS Engineer
positions.description:
As the first employee with an expertise in native app development, my role was to build a team of extremely talented engineers around me and develop the company's first mobile app for iOS, which we launched in October of 2015 and was immediately featured by Apple in the App Store for almost an entire year straight.

The project itself was written in Swift (started at version 1.1 of the language and kept up to date each year thereafter). I established the core architecture and testing infrastructure, which included a thorough combination of both unit and integration tests, and then HockeyApp builds for alpha testing, and TestFlight builds for beta testing. Additionally, I defined the Git branching strategy, code review process, and implemented a robost build pipeline for linting, compiling, running the test suite, and deploying, either locally or via CI. Lastly, I setup all of the certificates/provisioning and administered the Apple Developer, iTunes Connect, and Search Ads accounts.

Daily responsibilities included:

• Implement new features, fix bugs, and proactively tackle tech debt to minimize entropy
• Perform code reviews for all pull requests
• Manage the engineers on my team and mentor engineers across all disciplines/platforms
• Work with the backend team on defining new API endpoints and implementing careful, versioned changes for backwards compatibility with older clients
• Work with the design team to give feedback and ensure that the designs and UX are optimal for the platform
• Work with the product team to determine growth opportunities, maintain feature parity with other platforms, break features up into stories, prioritize tasks, etc
• Work with the recruiting team to find, interview, and hire engineers with a solid foundation, exceptional craftsmanship, and great personality
• Act as an ambassador on behalf of the entire engineering team to maintain a healthy line of communication with other teams throughout the company

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: Led the development of a new 3D mobile game for both iOS and Android using Unity. Oversaw, provided guidance, and contributed to all aspects of the project, from the graphics pipeline (shaders, texture baking, etc), to the C# codebase, native plugins, client and server-side architecture and communication, deep performance and memory optimizations, build system, and both Apple developer account and Perforce administration. Played a major role in the mentorship of engineers company-wide, pushed to improve code sharing between teams, and reduce entropy on both new and legacy projects through the use of more thorough automated testing and better architecture. Managed a portion of the engineers on my team, performed code reviews, and interviewed potential employees for multiple teams.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Guided the development of several different games cross-compiled for web, mobile, and Steam using Adobe AIR with custom native extensions. Heavily contributed to the development of an esoteric 3D graphics engine that was optimized for slower computers and mobile devices. Automated processes for testing and integration. Provided direction and mentorship to my teammates.

positions.title: Manager, Engineering
positions.description: Grew and managed the engineering teams in both the Atlanta and Boston offices. Led the planning, architecture, and development of high-profile mobile applications (iPhone and iPad) for a variety of fortune 500 companies (Time, Chrysler, etc), as well as a modern reinvention of the vending machine for Coca-Cola. Contributed to business development, mentored my peers, and played a major role in guiding the direction of technology.

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description: Responsible for the architecture, development, and documentation of large-scale, cutting-edge projects, including rich internet applications and native mobile applications (primarily iOS, but one Android app as well). Mentored senior, staff, and associate engineers. Performed code reviews, enforced standards and best practices, and interviewed potential employees. Clients included NBA, PGA Tour, Sony, and TBS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the development of several high-profile, award-winning rich internet applications. These unique, digital experiences pushed the boundaries of web technology at the time and included heavy use of animations, physics, and 3D realtime graphics before GPU access (WebGL, Stage3D, etc) was available for web apps. Mentored and provided guidance to other engineers on the team.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Broadly contributed to the engineering efforts for both Madden NFL and NCAA Football games on current (PS2, Xbox) and next-gen (PS3, Xbox 360) consoles. Proactively drove the documentation and enforcement of coding standards and best practices. Interviewed potential employees.
